summary: Myers Industries filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026, disclosing a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement under which it sold Myers Tire Supply, LLC to TAPS Holdings, LLC for $30 million cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments for cash, debt, net working capital and transaction expenses. The buyer obtained representation and warranty insurance as primary recovery for covered breaches. Myers agreed to 36-month non-compete and non-solicitation restrictions, with carve-outs for its international tire supply affiliates and Patch Rubber. Closing appears concurrent. Watch for adjustment mechanics, any purchase-price leakage, and how proceeds are deployed against leverage or buybacks.
